rebaseNote: Observed against d94e541b. origin/main advanced to c8b33a25 (PR #801) while this receipt was being written; PR #801 removed the mock handlers this receipt names. Findings were re-checked against c8b33a25 and only the mock-existence statement changed.
claim: CloudIdentity/Control-Plane login to Gateway usage page yields non-zero usage sourced from the real Gateway owner
verdict: The chain runs end to end against the real Sub2API owner. The non-zero assertion does NOT hold, for a legitimate reason unrelated to plumbing: the account's entire usage history predates the widest supported query window. The system reports this as status=available, available=true, which is the actual defect this receipt records.

environment.seeding: control_plane_users + control_plane_accounts inserted directly; sub2api_user_id=58. No in-repo bootstrap path exists (POST /api/operator/accounts is itself protected).

steps.name: Control Plane login delegates to Sub2API
Gateway account usage via real owner
steps.observed: source=sub2api; status=available; available=true; totalRequests=0; totalTokens=0; totalActualCostUsdMicros=0

steps.name: Gateway key usage via real owner

counterEvidence.purpose: Prove the zeros are a window artefact, not an unused account.
counterEvidence.conclusion: All 26 requests fall in 2026-08-29..2026-09-15. The account has been idle since. routes_gateway.go:916 accepts only today|week|month, so month (last 30 days = since 2026-09-13) structurally cannot show any of it.

findings.finding: available:true with an all-zero payload is indistinguishable from the mock that HEAD d94e541b added.
findings.detail: The real owner response {status:available, available:true, source:sub2api, data:{zeros}, fetchedAt} differs from the mock {status:available, available:true, source:gateway, data:{zeros}} only by the source string and fetchedAt. A reviewer cannot tell them apart from the payload.
findings.consequence: The audit's causal claim (the mock is why zeros appear) is inverted for the default path: apps/console-ui never issues an /api/v2/gateway request (zero grep hits), so the mock was unreachable. Removing it changes nothing the page shows. PR #801 (merge c8b33a25) subsequently deleted both mock handlers; this receipt was taken against the pre-#801 baseline d94e541b, and the finding survives the deletion because the real owner returns the same shape.
findings.status: mock removed upstream by c8b33a25; the ambiguity between 'no usage in window' and 'usage exists' is unresolved

findings.finding: The UI's default period cannot represent usage older than 30 days.
findings.detail: routes_gateway.go:916 admits only today|week|month and defaults to month. use-gateway-account-read-controller.ts:206 calls getGatewayAccountUsageSummary("month"). A funded account with 26 real requests still renders 0.
findings.consequence: 'I have no usage in this window' and 'I can never show you usage' present identically.

findings.finding: services/gateway-integration/identity has no usage capability at all.
findings.detail: identity.Gateway implements Login/Read/Balance/Models only; grep for usage|stats across the package's non-test files returns zero matches. The CloudIdentity owner cannot answer a usage question, so no BFF-side usage route can exist yet.
findings.consequence: A BFF path for usage has no owner to call. This is a code gap, not a config gap.

findings.finding: No bootstrap path exists for a fresh Control Plane database.
findings.detail: OPL_CONSOLE_USERS_JSON is retired (auth.go:52) and POST /api/operator/accounts is itself protected (routes_admin.go:489), so a fresh database cannot obtain its first user through the API. This receipt seeded by direct SQL.
findings.consequence: Every local run repeats this manual step; nothing fails loudly when it is skipped.

findings.finding: tools/local-sub2api-authority-fixture.ts can never return non-zero usage.
findings.detail: It answers /api/v1/admin/usage/stats with literal zeros, /api/v1/admin/usage with an empty page, hardcodes quota_used and usage_5h/1d/7d to 0, and does not implement the /api/v1/usage/stats user endpoint at all (customer_owned mode gets a 404).
findings.consequence: Any qualification lane relying on it can never evidence a non-zero usage claim.

notProven: The BFF/CloudIdentity session path was not exercised: it is not deployed by compose.yaml or Dockerfile, and OPL_CLOUD_IDENTITY_URL/TOKEN are absent from .env.
Audit item (c) (legacy Workspace create entering the BFF/Agent path) was not traced.
No browser render was captured; the readout was taken at the HTTP layer with a real session cookie.
Nothing was spent: the gateway was read only. No billable model call was made, so no new usage was created.
